title: Fill the Counter
story: A turnstile counts visitors. Every method needs the special first parameter.
hints: The first parameter of every method is the object itself, conventionally called self.
The second blank adds to the existing count: +=.
socratic: What is the first parameter of a method?
How do you add to an attribute?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did the blank teach you in “Fill the Counter”?
